# gtm_container_version_headers (Data Source)

Lists all Container Versions of a GTM Container.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `parent` (String) GTM Container's API relative path.

### Optional

- `all_pages` (Boolean) Follow next_page_token until every page has been retrieved. Defaults to true.
- `include_deleted` (Boolean) Also retrieve deleted (archived) versions when true.
- `page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.

### Read-Only

- `container_version_header_json` (String) All container version headers of a GTM Container.
- `next_page_token` (String) Continuation token for fetching the next page of results.
